findings.quote: manskapet gick ut på bråten med spett och hake
findings.note: class 1/6: lemma slip. The passage's own glossary and the rest of the text use 'bröt' (pl. def. 'brötarna', 'Knappt sju procent ... gäller brötar'), whose definite singular is 'bröten'. 'bråten' is the definite singular of 'bråte' (heap of debris/brushwood) — a different word. A copy editor catches the vowel mismatch instantly within 40 words of the glossed term. Native: 'gick ut på bröten'.

findings.quote: Brötarna skulle stå i mitten.
findings.note: class 6: idiomatic temperature. 'stå i mitten' is spatial ('be in the middle'); for 'be the focus of the study' edited sakprosa uses 'stå i centrum' (or 'stå i fokus'). Native: 'Brötarna skulle stå i centrum.'

findings.quote: en förklaring som hon själv kallar näraliggande snarare än bevisad
findings.note: class 1: form. Modern edited Swedish has 'närliggande'; 'näraliggande' is an archaic variant absent from current usage. The sense ('närliggande förklaring') is right, the derivation is not. Native: 'kallar närliggande snarare än bevisad'.

findings.quote: sjönk rensningsdagarna stadigt under hela perioden
findings.note: class 6: collocation. Days do not rise or fall; the text itself writes 'steg antalet rensningsdagar per flottad kubikmeter' two paragraphs earlier. Native: 'sjönk antalet rensningsdagar stadigt'.

findings.quote: Åtskilliga basar skrev bara ”flottning” och lät därmed frågan vara obesvarad
findings.note: class 6: collocation. The established verb here is 'lämna obesvarad'; 'låta ... vara obesvarad' is a constructed periphrasis. Native: 'och lämnade därmed frågan obesvarad'.

findings.quote: Skillnaden kan låta petig
findings.note: class 6: idiomatic temperature. Swedish concedes an anticipated objection impersonally — 'Det kan låta petigt, men ...'; making 'skillnaden' itself 'petig' attributes fussiness to the distinction rather than to the act of drawing it. Native: 'Det kan låta petigt, men ...'

findings.quote: den kommun som köper böcker och sedan låter dörren stå låst
findings.note: class 6: collocation. 'stå' pairs with 'öppen' ('dörren står öppen'); a locked door is 'hålls låst' / 'förblir låst'. Native: 'och sedan håller dörren låst'.

findings.quote: Bemannade skolbibliotek höjde både utlåningen och det källkritiska arbetet
findings.note: class 6: zeugma/collocation in student-visible option text. 'höja utlåningen' works, 'höja arbetet' does not. Native: 'ökade både utlåningen och det källkritiska arbetet'.

findings.quote: den har bara skrivits in i en karta
findings.note: class 6: preposition. Swedish places things 'på kartan' ('ritas in på en karta', 'står på kartan'); 'in i en karta' reads as a translationese container metaphor. Native: 'den har bara ritats in på en karta'.

findings.quote: manskapet gick ut på bråten med spett och hake
findings.note: class 1/6: the passage establishes and glosses the flottning term 'brötar' (sg. en bröt, def. sg. bröten), but here switches to 'bråten', the definite of the distinct word 'bråte' (debris pile). Mixing the two lexemes inside the same sentence pair as the glossary entry is a term inconsistency a copy editor catches; native: 'gick ut på bröten'.

findings.quote: i Rönnån, som rensades tidigt, sjönk rensningsdagarna stadigt under hela perioden
findings.note: class 6: 'sjunka' takes a quantity, not a count noun denoting days; the same passage earlier writes it correctly as 'steg antalet rensningsdagar'. Native: 'minskade rensningsdagarna' or 'sjönk antalet rensningsdagar'.

findings.quote: Bemannade skolbibliotek höjde både utlåningen och det källkritiska arbetet
findings.note: class 6: collocation miss in student-visible option text. 'Höja' collocates with nivå/kvalitet/löner/siffror, not with 'utlåning' or 'arbete'; the zeugma makes the second conjunct clearly off. Native: 'ökade både utlåningen och det källkritiska arbetet'.

findings.quote: skapa den tid lärare behöver för att planera tillsammans med någon
findings.note: class 6: the trailing 'med någon' is a vague dangling complement no native essayist would leave; native: 'för att planera tillsammans' or 'för att planera tillsammans med bibliotekarien'.

findings.quote: den har bara skrivits in i en karta
findings.note: class 6: wrong preposition/verb for maps. Swedish puts things 'på kartan' and 'ritar in' them (the passage's own opening uses 'ritas ett staket in'); native: 'den har bara ritats in på en karta'.

findings.quote: På de svagt använda platserna minskade dessutom inte klagomålen
findings.note: class 6: 'svagt använd' is an off collocation ('svagt' pairs with trafikerad/belyst); native: 'de lite använda' / 'de sällan använda platserna'.

findings.quote: manskapet gick ut på bråten med spett och hake
findings.note: class 1/6: the passage establishes and glosses 'brötar' (en bröt) and uses that lexeme elsewhere ('gäller brötar', 'brötarbetet'); the definite singular of bröt is 'bröten', not 'bråten'. 'bråte' is a different word (pile of debris/felled brush). Switching lexeme mid-sentence for the same referent is something a Swedish copy editor catches instantly; native alternative: 'gick ut på bröten med spett och hake'.

findings.quote: sjönk rensningsdagarna stadigt under hela perioden
findings.note: class 6: collocation miss. 'sjunka' takes a quantity/level as subject (priser, nivåer, antal), not a count noun denoting days. The text itself gets it right earlier ('steg antalet rensningsdagar per flottad kubikmeter'), which makes the slip internally inconsistent; native alternative: 'sjönk antalet rensningsdagar stadigt' or 'minskade rensningsdagarna stadigt'.

findings.quote: lät därmed frågan vara obesvarad
findings.note: class 6: unidiomatic temperature. The fixed Swedish phrase is 'lämna frågan obesvarad'; 'låta frågan vara obesvarad' reads as an assembled paraphrase. Native alternative: 'lämnade därmed frågan obesvarad'.

findings.quote: började lägga in moment om källkritik i sina egna kurser
findings.note: class 5: domain-register break. The study is of 'tjugoåtta grundskolor'; grundskolan has ämnen and undervisning, not 'kurser' (course terminology belongs to gymnasiet/högskolan). A Swedish education writer would not say that grundskolelärare put moment into 'sina egna kurser'. Native alternative: 'i sin egen undervisning' / 'i sina egna ämnen' — which is exactly the phrasing used in option C of q1.

findings.quote: höjde både utlåningen och det källkritiska arbetet
findings.note: class 6: collocation miss in student-visible option text (q1 D). 'Höja' does not take 'arbete' as object in Swedish, and 'höja utlåningen' is likewise off; the verb for volume of activity is 'öka'. Native alternative: 'ökade både utlåningen och det källkritiska arbetet'.

findings.quote: Underlaget är smalt: fyra kommuner, alla i samma län.
findings.note: class 6: the standard Swedish collocation for a thin evidence base is 'tunt underlag' or 'litet underlag' (cf. 'ett litet underlag' in comparable prose); 'smalt underlag' occurs but reads as a near-miss here. Native alternative: 'Underlaget är tunt'.

findings.quote: På de svagt använda platserna minskade dessutom inte klagomålen
findings.note: class 6: 'svagt använd' is a near-miss collocation. Swedish planning prose says 'svagt utnyttjade' or, in ordinary register, 'lite använda' / 'sällan använda'. The same phrase recurs in q1 option C. Native alternative: 'På de lite använda platserna' / 'de svagt utnyttjade platserna'.

findings.quote: Just att svaret så sällan följs upp har gjort det bekvämt.
findings.note: class 6: elliptical to the point of stumbling — 'göra det bekvämt' normally needs a beneficiary ('bekvämt för kommunerna') or a predicative complement. A copy editor would pause here. Native alternative: 'har gjort svaret bekvämt för kommunerna' / '… har gjort det till ett bekvämt svar'.

findings.quote: That the two ways of steadying a tower differ less in what they deliver at handover than in what becomes of it later.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick B): A reduces a main-idea answer to an anecdote about tourists plus the overclaim that the machine has stopped earning its keep, and D names a different subject entirely (underestimated wind loads, revised margins). That leaves the hedged comparative B against the one-sided C, which form alone does not decide - an opinion piece could legitimately key to C.

findings.quote: They fell as the buildings took on partitions and equipment, moving away from the settings the dampers had been given.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (blind pick D): adding mass lowers a structure's natural frequency, so D is reachable from first-year structural dynamics, and C is D's absolute twin (each of the nineteen, a full seven percent). A and B remain substantive positions, so the passage still does real work.

findings.quote: Rask says that a shape is tuned as well, though not to a frequency. What does the text suggest follows from this?
findings.note: PARTIALLY with a stem-entailment component: the stem supplies the premise that a shape is tuned to something other than a frequency, which pushes toward the surroundings reading in C. B contradicts the premise the stem sets up and D is a zoning prescription rather than a consequence, so only A and C survive blind.

findings.quote: He grants Marek that a shape outlasts its owners, while denying that this is what makes it the safer choice.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick A): an attitude stem with two eliminable extremes - C is full endorsement and D is full dismissal (a designer's vanity entirely discredited). A and B both survive, but A is the only concessive-plus-qualification shape, which is the usual key form for this stem type.

findings.quote: Its weight: a plug door of that period was far heavier than the square door it replaced, and heavier than the tools of the day could shift.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick B): A carries an absolute a passage would have to prove twice over (heavier than the tools of the day could shift), and C and D make overlapping roundness-distributes-force claims that cannot both be keys, which narrows to B. Against that, B is the only option that does not appeal to the door being round, a counter-tell, so form alone does not settle it.

findings.quote: To show that water can look blue where there is no sky to reflect and no colored surface to borrow from.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE (blind pick C): water is intrinsically blue through red-end absorption and the standard demonstration is exactly a white-lined indoor pool, so a reader who knows the physics picks C without the text. B and D are substantive real misconceptions (lining color, dissolved substances) that a passage would have to rule out, so this is normal comprehension work rather than a leak.

findings.quote: Ju noggrannare en sträcka hade rensats, desto fler rensningsdagar krävde den, oberoende av hur brant fallet var.
findings.note: PARTIALLY. Options B and C assert the same counterintuitive finding (more thorough clearing -> more clearing days); C is the unrestricted generalisation ('oberoende av hur brant fallet var') while B is scoped to the lowest stretches. The key/overgeneralised-twin pair is visible from form alone, with no domain knowledge, and narrows the field to two (blind pick B). Not decided blind: A and D remain formally possible. Normal distractor design, so flag not kill.

findings.quote: Hur mycket som rensades tycks ha styrts mer av föreningens skyldighet mot markägarna än av timrets värde.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, residual cross-question hint only. DECISIVE CHECK: the q3->q2 leak is REPAIRED - q3 no longer restates the September deadline, so q2's key can no longer be read off the question set. Residual: this q3 option, plus 'de sena utryckningarna' in q3 B, identifies the statutory duty as landowner-facing, which softly eliminates q2 B (a wage method, not a statutory duty) and q2 C (manning Nyhamn). A vs D stays undecided blind, and the elimination relies on assuming an unkeyed option's content is passage-true. Weak; routed to adjudication rather than passed.

findings.quote: Rensningsarbetet upphörde helt så snart årets flottning var avslutad.
findings.note: PARTIALLY. The stem's own term 'efterrensningen' presupposes clearing that continues after the season, so C ('upphorde helt sa snart arets flottning var avslutad') self-eliminates against the stem without the passage. B overreaches ('utan vidare rakna hem kostnaden') and D drifts to an income comparison, leaving A as the hedged on-topic option (blind pick A). Beats chance materially; not a pure-form leak of the key, so flag not kill.

findings.quote: Bemannade skolbibliotek ökade både utlåningen och det källkritiska arbetet på samtliga stadier i de fyra kommunerna.
findings.note: PARTIALLY. D overclaims on form (universal 'samtliga stadier' plus a causal 'okade bade ... och ...') and B denies any teaching-practice difference, so both fall blind. A and C are exact causal mirrors of one association (librarian -> source criticism vs source criticism -> librarian), so the key is visibly one of that pair, but the direction is not decidable without the passage (lean C). Mirror-pair distractors are legitimate design; flag, not kill.

findings.quote: Klagomålen på lösa hundar upphörde helt i alla parker där en inhägnad hade anlagts under de två åren.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick A): D is an absolute (upphörde helt, alla parker) no inventory would report, and B is A with the causal arrow reversed. B still stands as a substantive confound finding and C as a substantive displacement finding, so the eliminations narrow the field without settling it.

findings.quote: Frågan om hundrastgårdar handlar mindre om antalet än om var de placeras och för vem.
findings.note: PARTIALLY (blind pick D): A is a prescriptive absolute (bör inte byggas, bara flyttar sig), C generalises to urban densification which no dog-run inventory supports, and D is the sole hedged comparative of the shape this stem type usually keys to. B survives as a real possible headline result, and q:1 of the same set independently points at placement, so the pick leans on the question set rather than on the passage.
